meaning:
αὐγάζω
(αὐγή), [in LXX: Lev.13:24-28, 38 14:56 (בֹּהֶרֶת) Lev.13:39 (כֵּהֶה)* ;]
1. Trans. (cl.), to irradiate.
2. Intrans.
(a) (poët.), to see clearly (so perh. 2 Co, l.with; MM, see word)
(b) as in LXX, to shine forth: 2Co.4:4 (cf. δι-, κατ-αυγάζω).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should…
